def _components(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

            color = grid[r][c]

                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = set()
            while q:

                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:

                        q.append((yy,xx))
            result.append((color, cells))
    return result


def transform(grid):

    comps = _components(grid)
    markers = []
    for color, cells in comps:
        rs = [r for r, c in cells]
        cs = [c for r, c in cells]
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
        height, width = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
        if height < 3 or width < 3 or len(cells) != height + width - 1:

                      if (r,c) in cells
                      and all((r,x) in cells for x in range(c0,c1+1))
                      and all((y,c) in cells for y in range(r0,r1+1))), None)
        if elbow is not None:
            markers.append((color, cells, elbow, height, width, r0, r1, c0, c1))

        vertical_dir = -1 if er == r1 else 1
        horizontal_dir = -1 if ec == c1 else 1
        if height > width:
            ydir, xdir = vertical_dir, -horizontal_dir
        elif width > height:
            xdir, ydir = horizontal_dir, -vertical_dir
        else:

        candidates = []
